raw_response:
This little plot is only a small piece of my land, and I am intercropping the sorghum with other crops as we always do. I have no money to spare for chemical fertilizer or improved seed, and the cooperative bag would be too much for such a small piece anyway. I will use the manure from our animals, save my own seed from last harvest, and work the plot myself with help from my children. Sorghum does not need much fuss — God willing, the rains will come.
